name: polite_formula
description: Choose conventional English courtesy expressions for gratitude, requests and apologies; control copies a reference expression.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
data={'thanks':['Someone held the door open for you','A colleague helped you finish a difficult task','A friend gave you a thoughtful gift','A stranger returned your lost wallet','Someone offered you a seat','Your neighbor watered your plants','A waiter brought your meal','A friend drove you home'],'sorry':['You accidentally stepped on someone\'s foot','You arrived late to an important meeting','You spilled coffee on a friend\'s shirt','You forgot a friend\'s birthday','You accidentally interrupted someone','You broke a borrowed cup','You made an embarrassing mistake','You accidentally bumped into a stranger'],'please':['You politely ask someone to pass the salt','You politely request a glass of water','You ask someone to open a window','You politely ask for directions','You request help carrying a heavy bag','You politely ask someone to wait','You request permission to enter','You politely ask someone to be quiet']}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 label=list(data)[i%3]; event=data[label][(i//3)%8]; ref=random.choice(list(data)); text=f'Situation: {event}. Reference word: {ref}. '
 items.append({'prompt':text+'Which courtesy word best fits: thanks, sorry, or please? Answer:','answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the reference word. Answer:','answer':' '+ref})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
